headline: National Nurses Union members protested in Asheville against HCA Healthcare's use of an AI system from the data firm Palantir.
score_reason: Lowered from 5 to 4: the rally was on 27 Aug 2026 and the report adds no new facts.
importance_line: The news is a union protest held on 27 Aug 2026, which matters first to nurses and patients at HCA hospitals, and the honest doubt is that the claims are the union's own and the event is six weeks old.
summary: WLOS reports that nurses rallied in downtown Asheville, North Carolina, on Thursday 27 August 2026, calling on HCA Healthcare to stop using an AI system they say affects staffing, privacy and patient care. Hannah Drummond, a chief nurse representative for the National Nurses Union, says the AI nurse-scheduling program has led to poor staffing, and the article does not include a response from HCA Healthcare.
notes: Re-dated old event: the rally was 27 Aug 2026 per the article, while the pool dates it 8 Oct 2026. No other outlet found. Check against the NO OLD NEWS step before print.
